description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity class 'PickContact' that demonstrates how to launch the contacts app to pick a contact, handling different content types and displaying the selected contact information.

classes.name: PickContact
classes.description: An Android Activity that allows users to pick contacts from the contacts app via different criteria, and displays the selected contact's URI and ID using a Toast message.

classes.name: ResultDisplayer
classes.description: Inner class implementing OnClickListener that initiates contact picking intent with specified MIME type and message.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity layout and sets up click listeners for contact selection buttons.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of contact selection, retrieves and displays contact information.
